pr_body: Decode JSON request bodies and return an HTTP status with the parsed payload.
author: developer

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+def handle_request(request):
+    """Decode the request body into an HTTP status and JSON payload."""
+    import json
+
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(request["body"])
+    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return 400, None
+    return 200, payload
